task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three bounded implementation families: automatic-combat audio causality, dense-wave native qualification readiness, and a complete run shell with authored HUD choices and spatial integrity.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate still has a silent Effects stem with no automatic-attack source events, lacks native dense-profile frame-time qualification samples, and has not demonstrated the complete title-to-result/replay release matrix. The HUD choice surface also requires an explicit authored visual hierarchy.

stop_conditions: Preserve the authored cemetery package, retained lantern audio bindings, existing weapon resources, and ArenaCamera occluder/fade mechanisms.
Do not assign deferred finding.arena_camera_occlusion as an issue; spatial behavior is included only as the required arena_spatial_integrity capability.
Developer performs candidate repairs and focused self-checks only; host recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure remain external.

strategy.rationale: Cover each required gap exactly once with three coherent tasks. Make both active issues directly retestable while carrying the mandatory choice-visual and arena-spatial capabilities in the complete-run task.

code: Run targeted Godot/script checks for attack deduplication and cadence, dense pooling/reset, terminal transitions, draft application, and repeated retry cleanup.
Verify tester-only actions remain editor-guarded and preserved authored/imported assets are not replaced or destructively edited.
runtime: Host recaptures all three required release-convergence contracts with candidate-bound JSONL, runtime-state, audio, performance, and distributed-frame evidence.

Tester performs automatic-attack audio replay, native dense 1920x1080 three-cycle profiling, ordinary five-wave/boss run, failure/victory Result paths, three successful build-shape runs, and three clean retries.

Tester checks title/settings/upgrade/pause/death/victory/result focus across keyboard, mouse, and gamepad, plus spawn, route, central building/landmark, collision, boundary/perimeter, and ordinary movement/movement replay for disappearance or occlusion.
visual: Capture gameplay, level-up, Result, and dense-combat frames at the target viewport; verify moonlit cemetery composition, readable attack VFX, compact HUD hierarchy, truthful stat deltas, stable landmark visibility, and no placeholder/debug presentation.

done_when: One accepted lantern automatic attack emits exactly one recognizable bounded transient on the Effects bus with a non-silent stem and explicit source-event receipt.
Automatic cadence starts only after valid authorization, stops on release and lifecycle reset, and generic shot VFX never replays the retained player report.
Receipts distinguish onset, miss, character/concrete hit, metal hit, and disabled world-surface impact when material tags are unreliable.
Tester can black-box one automatic attack and white-box its authoritative event, source, bus, deduplication, and retirement receipt.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned lantern attack audio adapter and routing at the authoritative attack transaction. Trace source resolution, Effects-bus ownership, bounded windows, material classification, and reset retirement so valid onset and impact sources actually start and remain audible through mixer emission. Keep player report, impact semantics, enemy spatial cues, and VFX separate; prefer disabling unreliable world-surface impact audio over generic ringing placeholders. Add only candidate receipts needed for host recapture and preserve all currently bound authored recordings.
tasks.title: Restore automatic attack audio causality and bounded Effects routing

done_when: The dense profile maintains 25–40 active ordinary enemies with deterministic spawn, motion, presentation, pooling, and reset behavior and no unbounded per-frame allocation path.

Candidate samples expose frame, physics, render, draw, allocation, lifecycle, active/pooled entity, effects/audio, and runtime-error metrics with requested/resolved/reset-isolation and three-cycle provenance.
Three profile resets leave no stale actors, pickups, projectiles, effects, timers, signals, or counters while ordinary combat remains navigable and readable.
Tester can directly retest dense prepare/advance/reset and compare cycle samples and lifecycle receipts.
tasks.instructions: Harden the dense wave path and make native qualification possible. Inspect RunController profile lifecycle, DenseWaveProfile sampling, EncounterSpawner churn, enemy neighbor/steering updates, pooled pickup/effect cleanup, and reset ownership. Remove avoidable scene scans or allocations from sampled frames while retaining deterministic staggered non-authoritative presentation work. Keep tester-only setup editor-guarded and emit bounded renderer/preflight, sample-availability, entity-count, and reset-isolation receipts for native 1920x1080 three-cycle host capture.
tasks.title: Qualify dense-wave performance with bounded lifecycle sampling

done_when: A normal title-to-gameplay run reaches five waves, upgrade pauses, elite/boss transition, and failure or Bellkeeper victory, then a truthful Result and Retry/restart with no stale actors, timers, signals, audio, pause ownership, or HUD values.
Result shows time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt, damage taken, selected upgrades, truthful victory/failure, Credits & Notices access, and provenance visibility.

Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with authored silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, restrained copy, and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; never show NEW or LOCKED as a CURRENT value and omit unchanged/exhaustive rows.
Upgrade choices expose complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states with debounced confirmation and stable card dimensions.
Three distinct successful ordinary runs preserve focused-bolt, close-sweep, and orbiting-area-control build shapes.

The authored cemetery retains a larger traversable scale or coherent external world/external depth around the central building/landmark; collision and boundary/perimeter align with visible geometry, and ordinary movement/movement replay shows no pass-through, disappearance, or occlusion drift.
Tester can black-box title, first-run guidance, gameplay, draft, pause, failure, victory, Result, Retry, and replay, then white-box terminal/reset snapshots on the same candidate.
tasks.instructions: Complete the ordinary release shell around the existing run controller, draft controller, HUD, and authored cemetery. Bind terminal transitions and Result/Retry to one authoritative transaction while preserving statistics, build identity, credits/provenance, pause/input ownership, and clean reset across repeated retries. Keep first-run guidance brief, contextual, dismissible, InputMap-driven, and absent on later retries. Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy led by silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no NEW/LOCKED CURRENT placeholders, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states. For arena integrity, use direct collision/occluder isolation and authored datum alignment rather than repeating camera transform tuning; retain the intact native map and stable landmark visibility. Add candidate setup/reset receipts only where needed for host evidence.
tasks.title: Complete run lifecycle with authored choice hierarchy and arena integrity
